_README: Pool of test users + chats for Shimy load tests.
Copy this file to users.json (same folder) and fill it with REAL test credentials.
users.json is gitignored — only this example template is committed.
users[]  — list of 50 test accounts. Two consecutive users with the same pair_id form a chat-pair.
chats[]  — chat_id created in Shimy app for each pair_id (run the post → response → approve flow manually).
In chat tests, VUs from the same pair_id will WS-connect with their own token and exchange messages
in the chats[] entry that has the same pair_id.
Below: 4 example users (2 pairs, 2 chats). Replace with your 50 users / 25 chats.
